note: The query set is the most contestable part of a benchmark published by a participant. None of these queries were chosen to make us look good — see each block's rationale.

tasks.why: Agent tasks taken from THIRD-PARTY sources: the ARD spec's own examples (§5.3.1/§5.3.2) and the tasks a competitor advertises as its federation's strength. Playing on their turf: if we win here, it is not because of the set.
tasks.source: ard-spec spec/ard.md examples + competitor federation claims
queries: find me a flight booking agent
find an MCP server for weather

selfRetrieval.why: Our own representativeQueries, as published. Only interpretable in SOMEONE ELSE'S index: measuring them in our own is self-promotion. Published as-is, including the fifth, which our catalog entry deliberately leaves lower-ranked to avoid self-preferencing.
queries: how do I track what ChatGPT says about my brand
monitor brand mentions in AI search answers
alert me when my AI visibility drops
find an MCP server for this task

noiseFloor.why: Negative control. Strings with no meaning in any language. An honest registry returns ZERO; returning ten results with a high score reveals an undocumented noise floor, which is what makes a score useless for deciding anything.
